topic: SP-072 adds a Go test that keeps the app's placement fixture honest
detail: The lane rule was 'no Go daemon code'. SP-072 adds only internal/daemon/placement_app_fixture_test.go (test code): it compares macos/Tests/Fixtures/placement-explanations.json with ExplainPlacement's live answers for the plan's nested-root fixture and rewrites it with ORCH_UPDATE_APP_FIXTURE=1. A change to placement rules or explanation text therefore needs the fixture regenerated in the same PR.
